Hero.Title: Property management — your properties, on the owner's side
Hero.Description: Private property management in Geneva and across Switzerland for your residences and rental properties: leases, service charges, managing agents, works and reporting.

Intro: Once a property is bought, the real work begins: following the rent, checking statements, maintaining, insuring, declaring. Spread across several managing agents and residences, this follow-up quickly loses its coherence.

We administer your family's properties on the owner's side. Managing agents keep their operational role where they hold a mandate; we steer them, review their accounts and bring everything together in a clear view of your wealth.

Pillars.Title: Leases and rent
Pillars.Body: Tracking of leases, deadlines and rent receipts, reminders coordinated with the managing agent and a careful reading of rent adjustments.

Pillars.Title: Service charges and statements
Pillars.Body: Review of service charges and annual statements, questions raised with the right contact and follow-up until they are closed.

Pillars.Title: Steering managing agents
Pillars.Body: Framing mandates, tracking services and reviewing the accounts of your managing agents and building managers, in your interest as owner.

Pillars.Title: Maintenance and works
Pillars.Body: Coordination of maintenance and works with craftsmen and contractors, from quote to handover, in line with your renovation projects.

Pillars.Title: Building insurance
Pillars.Body: Follow-up of building and owner's liability insurance, renewals and claims, with your brokers and insurers.

Pillars.Title: Accounting and reporting
Pillars.Body: Owner-side accounting, consolidated reporting within the overall view of your wealth, and preparation of property data — including imputed rental value — for your tax returns, handled with your tax advisers.

Closing.Title: Properties looked after over time
Closing.Body: You decide the direction of your real estate. We provide its administration, coherence and memory, long after the signing.

Perimeter: Operational rental management remains with your managing agents where they hold a mandate, and legal and tax matters with your lawyers, notaries and tax advisers. Ridger provides administration, supervision, coordination and reporting. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.
